title: Sorting and Picture Graphs
seo_title: Kindergarten Sorting and Picture Graphs Worksheets (TEKS K.8)
standard_text: K.8A collect, sort, and organize data into two or three categories; K.8B use data to create real-object and picture graphs; K.8C draw conclusions from real-object and picture graphs
meta_desc: Free kindergarten data worksheets for Texas TEKS K.8: sort into groups, count, read picture graphs and compare data. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: The row with the most pictures is the most.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Sort things into 2 or 3 groups: by color, shape or kind.
  • Count each group.
  • In a picture graph, each picture is one thing. The row with the most pictures is the most.

Examples

Example

Dogs 5, cats 3

5 is more than 3

Answer: more dogs

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting a picture twiceTouch each picture once.
Reading the wrong rowFind the label first.
Picking the longest row by looksCount the pictures.
